# njX Classless

> njX Classless (npm: `classless-njxui`) is a classless CSS stylesheet: it styles plain semantic HTML — headings, buttons, forms, tables, dialogs, details — with zero class names, zero dependencies and zero build tools. 48 KB minified (~7 KB gzipped), 9 built-in themes via a single `data-theme` attribute. MIT license. The full component library (30+ components, utilities) lives at https://njxui.dev.

## Install

CDN (recommended — no build step):

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/classless-njxui@1/classless.min.css">
<html data-theme="dark">
```

npm: `npm install classless-njxui` → `import 'classless-njxui'` (also ships inside the `njx-ui` package as `css/classless.min.css`).

## Usage

No classes needed — write semantic HTML inside `<main>`, `<article>`, `<section>` or `<form>`:

```html
<main>
  <h1>Hello World</h1>
  <p>No classes. No setup. Just HTML.</p>
  <button>Get started</button>
  <input type="email" placeholder="your@email.com">
  <details><summary>FAQ</summary>Answer</details>
</main>
```

Scoping: styles activate only inside class-free `<main>/<article>/<section>/<form>` elements, so the file can coexist with other CSS.

## Themes

9 themes: dark (default), light, red, blue, green, cyan, yellow, pink, purple.
Switch with one attribute: `<html data-theme="purple">`. Variants via `data-variant` on elements.
